kurz: Usually fat is involved: a trace of yolk or a bowl that is not quite clean.
bild_im_kopf: Like soap bubbles with oily fingers: they burst straight away.

ursachen.titel: Fat or yolk in the whites
ursachen.warum: Even traces of fat stop a stable skin from forming around the air bubbles.
fix: Wipe the bowl and whisk with a little lemon

ursachen.warum: Sugar at the start makes whipping much slower.
fix: Sprinkle in the sugar only once soft peaks have formed

ursachen.warum: Over-whipped whites turn grainy, weep water and collapse.
fix: Whisking in a fresh egg white can rescue it

q1.frage: Does the foam not firm up at all?
antworten: It was stiff, then turned grainy

q2.frage: Did you add the sugar right at the start?
